nodes.author: Opus
nodes.norm_label: m0: build-sheet schema (locked, option c hybrid/tiered)
nodes.rationale: Hybrid/tiered — more when needed, lean when sufficient; global contracts (RBAC, NFR, release process) are defined once and referenced, never restated per module.

nodes.label: M2: Content Engine
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Operator-in-the-loop: nothing auto-publishes — every candidate requires operator approval (DEC-O01/O02) and persona comments are density-capped so AI never floods discussion.

nodes.label: M3: Content Qualification Rulebook
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: The LLM never decides a hard gate: hard rules are deterministic and fail-closed; GLM self-critique is allowed only for soft, operator-facing scores that never gate.

nodes.label: M4: Post System
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Single-owner-per-concern: comment engine, rating writes, AI authoring, and feed ranking are owned by M6/M5/M2/M9 — M4 owns only post structure and per-type mechanics.

nodes.label: M5: Tool Registry & Review Spine
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Honesty engine: the community aggregate derives only from active, passed, non-staff user toolRatings; editorial/persona verdicts never touch it.

nodes.label: M6: Discussion Engine
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: The moat is the packaging (the navigable discussion map), not a cleverer algorithm; MIN stays a clean read and MAX is strictly additive.

nodes.label: M8: AI Persona Engine
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Editorially governed, memory-grounded ambient intelligence that knows when NOT to speak: default-to-silence is a success outcome and every published persona comment is operator-approved and labeled.

nodes.label: M7: Posting Eligibility & Profile
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Open the door, earn the megaphone: posting is a right (verify + ~10s profile) and never points-gated — a firewall there 'just angers people'; reach is earned via Signal/trust.

nodes.label: M9: Feed & Discovery
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Biggest risk is a self-reinforcing distribution loop; fixed structurally (recorded qualified exposure, bounded exploration, diversity caps, Recognition firewall), never with a multiplier.

nodes.label: M11: Affiliate Storefront (BACKEND-LOCKED)
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.rationale: Creators keep 100% of commission and the platform takes zero — the moat is the built-in audience, trust layer and source-to-click attribution, not free tooling; an aggregate-only data bargain preserves the no-URL rule via an approved, locked BUY redirect.

nodes.label: M12: Signals, Recognition, Might & the Ladder (BACKEND-LOCKED)
nodes.author: Opus
nodes.norm_label: m12: signals, recognition, might & the ladder (backend-locked)
nodes.rationale: Safe to make public only because a hidden per-actor legitimacy score makes it un-gameable (the one deliberate transparency exception); earned VALUE (Signals/Might) drives distribution while social STATUS (Recognition→Awards) stays cosmetic and never feeds value, ranking, trust or reach.

nodes.label: M10: Constellation — Free Resource Store (BACKEND-LOCKED)
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Never serve user-uploaded bytes publicly (malware + copyright laundering) — the platform forges original Createconomy resources from authorized claims; soft beta ships Path B with constellation.ugc.enabled=false (in-house library only).

nodes.label: M13: Trust, Safety & Moderation (CONFIRMED + CLOSED)
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Lean ops spine for ≈1–2 humans — enterprise patterns, not ISO theatre: every intake becomes one moderationCases record, humans decide sanctions, no LLM auto-ban, and hold queues get a forcing function (allowlisted S3 auto-release at 96h) so 'private forever' is never silent censorship without fail-open publish.

nodes.label: M14: Onboarding & Retention (CONFIRMED + CLOSED)
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Port proven market patterns (Duolingo/Canva/Linear/Discord/Reddit/Epic), don't invent greenfield ritual; drip + quota are one mechanic — drip without quota is binge-and-leave, quota without drip is frustration. Honest empty states, no fabricated social proof.

nodes.label: M15: Admin & Ops Console (CONFIRMED + CLOSED)
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: One cockpit for 1–2 humans: widgets not orphan pages, typed Tuesday config with blast radius, an owned STOP that never auto-resumes, a baked-in Wiki for ops literacy, and intervention alerts only when human action is required — enterprise patterns, not Trust-org theatre.

nodes.label: M1: Platform Foundation (CONFIRMED + CLOSED)
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Wiring layer that makes locked M2–M18 executable — identity creation, default membership and admission are server facts; browser context finalizes under fail-closed bootstrapState; M1 does not re-own M15 chrome or M18 jobs/CMP.

nodes.label: M16: Analytics & Instrumentation
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Analytics is the prized possession: rawEvents is the sole ledger (PostHog an exploration lens only) and the Founder weekly review must end in ≤3 owned decisions — not vanity DAU wallpaper.

nodes.label: M17: Growth, SEO & Distribution
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Growth comes from founder-video UTMs plus trustworthy indexable supply — never an AI content farm; human review is made machine-visible as scaled-content-abuse defence and AI Act Art. 50 compliance.

nodes.label: M18: Reliability & Platform Ops
nodes.author: PM
nodes.rationale: Soft beta is not a demo: durable jobs with bounded retries, liveness (not lastStatus) health, consent that never erases the rawEvents ledger, ordered two-system rollback, and attribution ≠ authorization on the scheduled path.

nodes.label: convex-insights Skill
nodes.rationale: Discipline copied from the observability MCP surface that works best in the wild: discover fields before querying, three views not fifteen tools, token-frugal output, dashboard deep link on every answer.

nodes.label: convex-launch-readiness Skill
nodes.rationale: Readiness is the union of the checks, deduped, ranked, and scored — so it composes the audit capabilities' findings-bus outputs instead of re-implementing any check inline.

nodes.label: convex-migrate-rehearse Skill
nodes.rationale: A Convex schema push validates every existing document and fails on non-conformance, so the change is rehearsed on a preview seeded with a prod snapshot — the gate fails on a copy, not prod.

nodes.label: convex-migrate Skill
nodes.rationale: Never tighten a validator before the backfill completes — it rejects existing rows and breaks the live app; new fields land optional first, then migrate, then require.

nodes.label: convex-monitor Skill
nodes.rationale: Block on the next typed event instead of polling; a poll loop with the SAME event contract is the fallback only where blocking MCP is weak.

nodes.label: convex-optimize Skill
nodes.rationale: The assessment is delegated to launch-readiness; optimize's distinct value is the actions taken on the report (stale-component upgrades + observability install).

nodes.label: convex-quickstart Skill
nodes.rationale: Minimal by design (local dev servers, no publish step, no pre-baked auth); if the scaffold cannot run, skip the recipe and write a standard Convex project directly — code, not ceremony.

nodes.label: convex-reviewer Skill
nodes.rationale: Always explain why a change is needed, not just what to change; severity-ranked Convex-specific checklist (Critical/Important/Suggestion).

nodes.label: convex-self-heal Skill
nodes.rationale: Error rows live in the user's own deployment and the fix can be rehearsed on a preview of it, so the fix is certified against real invariants before anyone reviews it; the human keeps the merge button.

nodes.label: convex-sentinel Skill
nodes.rationale: Redaction is mandatory and on by default because the agent's reads reach the model provider; data stays in the user's own deployment.

nodes.label: convex-suggest Skill
nodes.rationale: Passive by design — never interrupt the current task; one component at a time, anchored in the user's own code, and never install without explicit consent.

nodes.label: convex-test Skill
nodes.rationale: Use convex-test (in-memory), not a live deployment; keep tests deterministic (no real time/network).

nodes.label: convex-verify Skill
nodes.rationale: A green typecheck does not prove a non-owner is denied; the highest-value assertions are the NEGATIVE ones — exactly the authz defects a happy-path demo never catches.
